subject: System Design
title: The British Airways Data Center Fire
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The British Airways Data Center Fire.

hook.text: In 2017, a power surge at a British Airways data center caused a cascading failure across all systems.

buildup.text: An engineer disconnected and reconnected a power supply, causing an uncontrolled power surge.

discovery.text: The surge fried servers in the primary data center. The backup data center failed to take over cleanly.

twist.text: BA had outsourced its IT operations years earlier. The institutional knowledge to recover quickly was gone.

climax.text: 75,000 passengers were stranded. The outage cost BA over £80 million in compensation and lost revenue.

punchline.text: A power surge grounded 75,000 passengers for three days.

quiz.question: What worsened the British Airways data center failure?
options: The backup data center failed to take over cleanly
They had no backup at all
